sources.beginner: hand-calc: cubic least-squares fit, 400-step BEP scan, affinity map and brake power taught in beginner m02-m04 and /root/wt-b5-nextgen/src/content/courses/esp/beginner/m06-the-associate-reading/l02-working-the-capstone.md; pd-stage-explorer is select-only teaching curves (StageExplorer.jsx:151,333) and the panel capstone guard keeps OKARI-9 out of panels
sources.intermediate: hand-calc: intake pressure, GVF, mass-weighted density, in situ rate, TDH and ceiling stage count taught in intermediate m01-m05 and m06/l02-working-the-capstone.md; pd-lift-explorer is select-only published cases (LiftExplorer.jsx:596)
sources.advanced: hand-calc: shaft hp, plate-scaled amps, AWG pick with the five resistances and the 0.0021833333/degF slope printed in advanced m03/l02-l03, surface kVA and loss (m04), head ratio (m05); pd-power-explorer is select-only (PowerExplorer.jsx:204). The Suite EspDesignStudio is not named and prints 0-2 decimals (src/components/esp/ElectricalPanel.jsx:44-100)

fields.evidence: Cubic least squares on the six published points (rate scaled by the top rate), RMSE = sqrt(SSE/n): reproduced 0.02217275280580838 exactly with the vendored fitStageCurve; l03 calibrates the /n convention on the golden curve (0.0534522484 ft).
fields.notes: No reporting precision stated; tol is about 5e-7 relative, so a learner must carry about seven significant figures from a spreadsheet. Probe shows no panel number within tol.

fields.notes: Answer lies on a 401-point grid (1750 + k x 7.875); tol 0.0018 is well inside half a step, and 401 values is not guessable.
